CustomField.description: True while this contact holds a current Board Term. Maintained by automation, not entered by hand: BoardTermService refreshes it whenever a Board Term changes, and BoardMemberFlagRefresh re-checks every board contact nightly because Board_Term__c.Is_Current__c is date-driven and can flip with no DML on the record. Cannot be a roll-up summary - Board Term relates to Contact by lookup, not master-detail. Used by the JSI-87 acknowledgment router to pick the board thank-you letter. JSI-87 / JSI-123 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. Ticked while the contact holds a current Board Term.
